name: Blue

comments.author: PhantomKraken87
comments.content: Blue is such a brain teaser! Level 15 had me stuck for hours, but finally turning the screen blue felt so satisfying!

comments.author: NeonRevolver_X
comments.content: Who knew making everything blue could be this challenging? Blue keeps surprising me with its clever puzzles!

comments.author: Witcher4Lyfe
comments.content: Just finished Blue, and wow, the level designs are genius! Can't wait for the next color in the series.

comments.author: NoobMaster9000
comments.content: Blue is fun, but man, some levels are brutal. Still, it's addictive—I can't stop playing!

comments.author: xX_CosmicKatana_Xx
comments.content: Blue is a gem! The puzzles are so unique, and the satisfaction of solving them is unmatched.

comments.author: StalkingPhoenix99
comments.content: Blue is the perfect mix of challenge and fun. Level 20 had me scratching my head, but I got there!

comments.author: SavageBroadsword_42
comments.content: Blue is a must-play for puzzle lovers. The way each level introduces new mechanics is brilliant.

comments.author: LagWarriorXX
comments.content: Blue is so addictive! I keep telling myself 'one more level,' and suddenly it's 2 AM.

comments.author: CtrlAltDefeat
comments.content: Blue is a great follow-up to the other color games. The 25 levels are packed with creativity!

comments.author: PotionMishap
comments.content: Blue is a fantastic puzzle game. The challenges are tough but fair, and the blue screen reward is worth it!

userInputText: After Yellow, Red, and Black, now you got Blue, another puzzle game for you! Can you make the screen blue in all 25 levels? Each level has its own challenge.
